Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight-cut bangs and a silky texture. Warm amber-colored eyes with a bright, cheerful expression. Appears to be in late teens with a youthful, energetic face. Slender, athletic build with a pair of chestnut-brown horse ears and a long, matching chestnut-brown horse tail. Wears a white and light-blue racing outfit with gold accents and a small white bow.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
